historical_references.reference: Ananda Tirtha, also known as Ananyanagalla Ananda Tirtha Swamiji, was a 15th century Vijayanagara era Hindu monk and scholar from the Matha of Udupi in Karnataka, India. He was a philosopher, theologian, and poet, and played a crucial role in the revival of the Dvaita philosophy during the Bhakti movement.
